outcome: Cesarean section for intrapartum fetal compromise (IFC)
Admission to the neonatal intensive care unit for >24 h
cohort: 203 singleton pregnancies delivered at term (37 + 0−41 + 6) in a single tertiary referral center over a six-year period
finding: A low CPR was associated with composite APO in SGA fetuses, while VSGA fetuses were more frequently affected by composite APO regardless of Doppler values.
